momentum_note: The Outage Anxiety Economy is accelerating across all 8 companies. The signal is not just volume growth but structure change: consequence inflation is visible in pricing (Digital Realty lease rates 4x higher), contract visibility (Generac, Cummins, Kinder Morgan all signing hyperscale and data-center deals), and capex intensity (EMCOR and Comfort Systems backlogs surging 44% and 73%). The winners are not commodity suppliers but those controlling capacity — backup generation, resilience construction, power distribution, and grid-edge infrastructure. Bifurcation is real: hyperscalers and mission-critical operators pay premium prices to eliminate outage consequence; others absorb managed outages. This is no longer an outage-frequency story; it is a consequence-pricing story.
